## I want to checksum and qc my data AND want to start mapping for my project

```{bash}
head ../data/raw/filtered_LTL_PL59_TGACCA_L005_R1.fastq
```


Checksum

```{bash}
md5sum ../data/raw/filtered_LTL_PL59_TGACCA_L005_R1.fastq

```

```{bash}
md5sum ../data/raw/*

```




#fastqc


```{bash}
/home/shared/FastQC-0.12.1/fastqc ../data/raw/filtered_LTL_PL59_TGACCA_L005_R1.fastq
```


# multiqc


```{bash}
/home/shared/MultiQC.v1.12.dev0/multiqc -h
```



# trimming 

```{bash}
/home/shared/fastp
```


```{bash}
/home/shared/fastp \
-i ../data/raw/filtered_LTL_PL59_TGACCA_L005_R1.fastq \
-o ../data/trimmed_filtered_LTL_PL59_TGACCA_L005_R1.fastq
```

#fastqc


```{bash}
/home/shared/FastQC-0.12.1/fastqc ../data/trimmed_filtered_LTL_PL59_TGACCA_L005_R1.fastq
```
